mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic activity, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate > 0.5% in the prior quarter but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing risk-free rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% in the prior month but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and stable CPIAUCSL (inflation < 2% annualized) indicates accommodative policy without inflationary pressure, generating positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 240 but 20-day returns negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.5% reflects tight labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.5% but 20-day forward returns negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% in the prior quarter signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings forecasts and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline > 2% but 20-day returns positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units indicate weak construction sector activity, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1300 but 20-day returns positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) above 145,000 thousand persons indicates robust labor market, supporting wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 145,000 but 60-day forward returns negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index above 240 indicates elevated inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 240 but 5-day forward returns positive in > 60% of cases.
